name: Search documents
description: Search Rechtspraak and ECHR case law. Uses the hosted Case Law Explorer service, which needs an access token you create yourself — the platform keeps it on the server and never shows it to the people using it.

config.label: Case Law Explorer access token
config.help: Required. Sign in, generate a key, and paste it here. It is written to the exported platform's credentials.json rather than into the pipeline, and every request is made by the platform itself — so the people using it never see the token. Anyone holding the exported folder does, so pass that folder on as carefully as the token itself. A deployment can leave this blank and set CITATIONS_API_KEY instead.

config.label: Service address
config.help: The hosted service. Change this only to point at your own deployment.
